profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Our team is building out an advanced platform to automate the Netflix experience across thousands of devices over hundreds of partners.   This platform is made up of a series of hardware, software and cloud components that are used to control and replicate real world conditions for devices in the wild.  This is done by, for example, duplicating remote functions and controlling the device’s network and power, thereby allowing cameras, microphones, and other types of sensors to interface with the device.  These sensors work faster than a human and also offer unbiased data.   This all results in higher quality devices delivered faster to the customer.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: I manage a team that focuses on the UI for Netflix's Partner Tools.  We build the tools that validate a device is up to Netflix's standards.  This is done through a cloud based automation suite that is backed by a custom CRM, web analytics and client/device side Javascript.

positions.title: Sr. Front End Engineer
positions.description:
I work on the following systems within the Partner Tools Organization: 
- Analytics - Allow users to quickly see trends in millions of records of test data that is cross referenced across several databases through real time analytics.
- Netflix Test Studio - an RIA that provides powerful Client Automation and device testing. This application enables hundreds of devices to be tested from anywhere in the world.
- Client Automation - working with the Production UI and Client Application teams we build embedded JS components to enable remote testing and automation.
- Partner Device Portal - A comprehensive CRM system that provides administrative interfaces for the settings and properties of all devices in Netflix. This system serves as the gateway for all devices into Netflix.

Primary development is done with AngularJS, Bootstrap, and varies other plugins.   We also do work with ExtJS and write several cross functional libraries in raw JavaScript.

positions.title: Sr. UI Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed the architecture for an event driven JavaScript platform to display satellite and ground station telemetry in near real time.  Spoke at jQuery Conf 12 about this architecture: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RaZaLCbfF-Q
-Built a web application that reads in an engineering schematic in SVG and allows engineers to associate real time space craft data to quick diagnose the state of the system.
-Worked with google maps api for the display of satellite imagery.
-Created a SQL autocomplete application as an engineer's interface to satellite data.
-Utilized real time technologies such as Websockets and previously comet for the streaming of critical data.
